text:
[issue by laji233]
### Bug Description

If you launch the game once with both Create: Aeronautics and Sodium loaded, uninstalling Create: Aeronautics and restarting the game will cause the game to crash.

### Reproduction Steps

1.Neoforge 21.1.233 for Minecraft 1.21.1
2.Sodium 0.8.12 and Create Aeronautics 1.3.0
3.launch the game
4.exit the game
5.delete Create Aeronautics
6.restart the game

### Log File

[latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29452105/latest.log)

### Crash Report

[crash-2026-06-29_13.26.29-client.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29452110/crash-2026-06-29_13.26.29-client.txt)

[comment by jellysquid3 (member)]
```
java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: dev/simulated_team/simulated/ponder/instructions/CustomAnimateWorldSectionInstruction
	at TRANSFORMER/create_dragons_plus@1.11.2b/plus.dragons.createdragonsplus.integration.simulated.client.ponder.CDPSEPonderScenes.register(CDPSEPonderScenes.java:32)
```

Your problem is because mod loading failed, because _Create: Dragons Plus_ depends on _Create._
